# Guangzhou Phone Farm (phonefarm.cn)

> Phone farm box manufacturer in Guangzhou, China — factory-direct hardware for development, testing and multi-device automation. RFQ-based sales with optional USDT checkout on select SKUs.

## Brand

Guangzhou Phone Farm supplies real-device phone farm boxes, Android motherboard arrays, 32PCS phone farm chassis, 12PCS hot-swap arrays, iPhone farm boxes, enterprise network routers/switches for OTG/LAN, ROM customization and remote AnyDesk setup support.

## Core Products

- **Android Motherboard Box** — 20 nodes, 55×38×16 cm, ~7 kg, 220V ~100W, USB + OTG/LAN, 1 PC controls 3–5 boxes
- **32PCS Phone Farm Box** — unified 32-device chassis, ROM customization, 3-fan cooling
- **12PCS Phone Array** — hot-swappable drawers, full phone or motherboard, built-in PC option, USB 2.0 HUB
- **iPhone Farm Box** — iOS multi-device chassis, custom quote
- **Network Management Router** — enterprise IK-MSG series for 300–10,000 device farms
- **Enterprise Network Switch** — L2/L3 and PoE switches for LAN expansion
- **Accessories** — USB hub, power module, cooling kit, empty chassis
- **OEM Custom Cabinet** — rack/floor cabinet engineering
- **Remote Setup Service** — ADB, OTG/LAN, WSAPI orientation

## Connection Modes

- **USB mode** (blue LED) — devices via USB to control PC; best for small labs
- **OTG/LAN mode** (green LED) — devices on router segment; scan by IP; scales past USB limits
- VPN/proxy supported for IP rotation workflows

## Group Control & Automation

- Works with click farm / group-control software after ADB authorization
- WebSocket API (WSAPI) at 127.0.0.1:22223 — List, Screen, ADB, PointerEvent, file transfer actions
- ADB authorization path: C:\Users\<username>\.android

## Application Fields (legitimate use)

Mobile app testing, Android QA, device compatibility verification, automation workflows, click farm operations, multi-device monitoring, software integration testing, enterprise device labs. Hardware for development and testing only.

## Sales Model

- RFQ via contact form, email, WhatsApp, Telegram
- Sample orders available (1 box / 12PCS array)
- List prices on select SKUs with USDT checkout; bulk quotes configuration-based
- Custom-assembled units: no return after dispatch
- Warranty: chassis 12 months, motherboards 90 days, accessories 12 months

## PC Requirements (typical)

- Windows 10/11 for control PC
- 3–5 boxes: Xeon E5-2680 V2 class or better, 32 GB RAM recommended
- USB 2.0 powered hubs; enterprise router for 300+ OTG/LAN devices
